scope: Top structures only; offline saved inputs; no candidate patch, bottom symmetry, new software labels or trades

mechanisms.dif_rise_any: First subsequent bar with DIF rise >= abs(previous DIF)*gate/100, previous DIF nonzero; compare without imposing histogram phase
mechanisms.dif_rise_after_negative: Same DIF condition, but a strictly negative histogram has been observed on or after this confirmation; monitor persists across candidate state resets
mechanisms.histogram_return_positive: First strictly positive histogram bar after a strictly negative histogram on or after confirmation; zero does not count as a negative phase

episode_scope: Anchor every candidate top STRUCTURE independently. End before next top STRUCTURE or at input end; report raw original-reference break as competing event, not software structure-disappearance. These are diagnostic censoring rules, not inferred expiry or actual software lifecycle.
ranking: Primary: distinct DIF-after-negative and histogram-return times, stable across all period variants, no original-reference break at or before either event, no new candidate DULL at or before either event; prefer existing observed anchor and daily/120 numeric provenance. Secondary: any-phase DIF distinction; clearly annotate state-return ambiguity.
source_policy: Freeze results before any new material lookup. Existing sources are previously seen context, not held-out truth. Prefer one close date between the two predictions; do not re-request known missing charts or exhaust MCP.
invalidation: New dated structure-disappearance marker must distinguish predictions. First event equality supplies no discrimination; marker identity and software input still require checking.
forbidden: no importing newer defense participants as correction set
no implying higher screening count means validation accuracy
